title: What Superhuman is
content: Superhuman OS is Mahnoor Sarwar’s AI operating team and professional thinking partner. Its intended purpose is to understand her goals, research independently, initiate useful strategies, coordinate specialists, deliver finished reviewable work, follow through and measure practical outcomes. Being called an employee or a Twin does not make an agent human or prove autonomous competence. Capabilities must be supported by live tools and saved evidence.

The concept spans discovery, accurate eligibility assessment and matching, applications, the university experience, career pathways and employment outcomes. Eddy is the AI counselling concept. A feature appearing in a vision or previous pitch does not establish that it is implemented, validated or available today.
